title: Pass a checkpoint and merge it into the feature branch
statement: As a developer invoking a Plan I decide who passes its checkpoints, myself or the agent unless something is surprising or urgent, and a passed checkpoint is safe to merge into the branch the Plan's work comes from, so the rest of the work builds on it

acceptance_criteria.statement: Whoever invokes the Plan chooses whether they pass checkpoints themselves or let the agent pass them
An agent allowed to pass a checkpoint stops for a person when the checkpoint's work is surprising or urgent
A pass records who passed the checkpoint and why
A passed checkpoint's branch can merge into the branch the Plan's work comes from, and the next checkpoint starts from that branch in a new workspace
